proposals.action_title: Publish First KDP Coloring Book via Together AI (FLUX-schnell)
proposals.why_this_works_now: Together AI offers FLUX-schnell for free during trial/low-usage tiers. High-quality vector-style coloring pages can be compiled into a PDF via GitHub Actions using Python (ReportLab/FPDF) and pushed directly to KDP, bypassing the need for a desktop computer.
proposals.first_action_today: Activate Together AI free tier key, plug it into TOGETHER_API_KEY in GitHub Secrets, and run the 'produce_coloring_book' pipeline.

proposals.action_title: Upload 50 Text-Only & Simple Vector Sticker Designs to Redbubble
proposals.why_this_works_now: Text-heavy and simple vector designs (using 'produce_iheart_v4' or 'produce_literal_idioms_v2') do not require heavy GPU image generation. Stickers have a low barrier to purchase and require zero inventory, generating immediate organic search sales on Redbubble.
proposals.first_action_today: Configure 'produce_literal_idioms_v2' to output 50 high-resolution transparent PNGs to a GitHub Release, download them to Android, and upload them via Redbubble's mobile-friendly bulk uploader.

proposals.action_title: Deploy 5 Ultra-Niche Local French Logbooks on KDP
proposals.why_this_works_now: Using 'produce_chateau_local' or simple regional hiking/mushroom hunting logbooks in French ('Carnet de Chasse aux Champignons', 'Carnet de Randonnée Vosges') targets hyper-specific local queries with virtually zero competition on Amazon.fr.
proposals.first_action_today: Run the 'produce_chateau_local' script to generate interior PDFs and clean cover layouts tailored to French regional tourists.

proposals.action_title: List 10 Parametric 3D Printing STL Files on Cults3D
proposals.why_this_works_now: Cults3D is a highly active, search-driven marketplace for 3D printers. Using 'produce_stl_parametric' with OpenSCAD via Termux allows generating functional, customizable 3D models (like gridfinity boxes or cable organizers) that sell for 1-3 EUR repeatedly.
proposals.first_action_today: Generate 10 variations of functional organizational STLs using OpenSCAD in Termux, take high-quality render screenshots, and upload them to Cults3D as paid downloads.

proposals.action_title: Launch a 'Pay-What-You-Want' 2D Game Asset Pack on itch.io
proposals.why_this_works_now: Game developers constantly search itch.io for GUI assets, icons, and tilemaps. By outputting pixel-art or vector assets using Cloudflare Workers AI (free 10k neurons/day) and packaging them as 'Pay-What-You-Want' (with a suggested $2 price), you capture frictionless impulsive tips.
proposals.first_action_today: Run 'produce_gamedev_asset_pack' using Cloudflare Workers AI to generate a UI Icon set (fantasy or sci-fi theme), zip the files, and publish the project page on itch.io.

proposals.action_title: Optimize Redbubble Listings with Automated Semantic Tag Bundling
proposals.why_this_works_now: Redbubble's search algorithm relies heavily on tag relevance. Using a simple Python script on Termux to fetch top trending tags in your niche and append them to your uploaded designs increases organic search impressions by up to 300% without paying for ads.
proposals.first_action_today: Write a quick Termux script that outputs a comma-separated list of 15 highly relevant, non-spam tags for each of your active Redbubble designs based on Google autocomplete.
